prompt:
You are grading two formalizations of a mathematical proof in the Lean theorem prover.

A formalization is FAITHFUL if its structure mirrors the natural-language (NL) proof: the same intermediate steps, under the same assumptions, in the same order -- not merely a proof that reaches the same conclusion by some other route.

Here is the NL statement being proved:
---
For finite index sets $I,J$, a matrix supported on
$T\subseteq I\times J$ means a real matrix whose entries outside $T$ are
zero; entries in $T$ are allowed to vanish.

\begin{lemma}[Kernels at maximum support rank]\label{lem:kernel-support}
Let $T\subseteq I\times J$, where $I$ and $J$ are finite.  Suppose that
$D:\R^J\to\R^I$ has maximum rank among all real matrices supported on $T$.
Then, for every $x\in\ker D$, every $y\in\ker D^{\mathsf T}$, and every
$(s,j)\in T$, one has $x_jy_s=0$.
---

Here is the NL proof whose reasoning the Lean code is supposed to mirror:
---
Suppose instead that $x_jy_s\ne0$.  For a nonzero real $\tau$, the matrix
$D_\tau=D+\tau e_s e_j^{\mathsf T}$ is still supported on $T$, and
\[
 D_\tau x=\tau x_j e_s.
\]
Thus $e_s\in\im D_\tau$.  Moreover, for every $w\in\R^J$,
\[
 Dw=D_\tau w-\tau w_j e_s\in\im D_\tau,
\]
so the entire old image $\im D$ is contained in $\im D_\tau$.
On the other hand, $y$ annihilates $\im D$ and $y_s\ne0$, so
$e_s\notin\im D$.  Therefore $\rank D_\tau>\rank D$, a contradiction.
---

FORMALIZATION A:
```lean
namespace OAI

namespace SeymourSecondNeighborhood.LinearAlgebra.MaxSupportKernel

variable {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]

def SupportedOn (T : Set (I × J)) (D : Matrix I J ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s j, (s, j) ∉ T → D s j = 0

theorem range_lt_range_add_single [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (D : Matrix I J ℝ) {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hx : D *ᵥ x = 0) (hy : Dᵀ *ᵥ y = 0)
    (s : I) (j : J) (hxj : x j ≠ 0) (hys : y s ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin <
      LinearMap.range (D + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ)).mulVecLin := by
  let E : Matrix I J ℝ := D + Matrix.single s j 1
  let e : I → ℝ := Pi.single s 1
  change LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin < LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin
  have hsingle (w : J → ℝ) :
      Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ) *ᵥ w = w j • e := by
    ext i
    simp [Matrix.single_mulVec, Function.update_apply, Pi.single_apply, e]
  have hEw (w : J → ℝ) :
      E.mulVecLin w = D.mulVecLin w + w j • e := by
    change (D + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ)) *ᵥ w = D *ᵥ w + w j • e
    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, hsingle]
  have hEx : E.mulVecLin x = x j • e := by
    rw [hEw]
    change D *ᵥ x + x j • e = x j • e
    rw [hx, zero_add]
  have he : e ∈ LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin := by
    have hm : x j • e ∈ LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin := ⟨x, hEx⟩
    have hs := (LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin).smul_mem (x j)⁻¹ hm
    simpa only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxj, one_smul] using hs
  have hle : LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hm : E.mulVecLin w ∈ LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin := ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hs := (LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin).sub_mem hm
      ((LinearMap.range E.mulVecLin).smul_mem (w j) he)
    rw [hEw] at hs
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hs
  have hnot : e ∉ LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin := by
    rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    have ha : dotProduct y (D.mulVecLin w) = 0 := by
      change dotProduct y (D *ᵥ w) = 0
      rw [← Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec D w y, hy, dotProduct_zero]
    rw [hw] at ha
    exact hys (by simpa [e] using ha)
  exact lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hle, fun hge => hnot (hge he)⟩

theorem kernel_support_of_max_rank {T : Set (I × J)} {D : Matrix I J ℝ}
    (hD : SupportedOn T D)
    (hmax : ∀ A : Matrix I J ℝ, SupportedOn T A → A.rank ≤ D.rank)
    {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hx : D *ᵥ x = 0) (hy : Dᵀ *ᵥ y = 0)
    {s : I} {j : J} (hsj : (s, j) ∈ T) :
    x j * y s = 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra hxy
  have hxj : x j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hxy (by rw [h, zero_mul])
  have hys : y s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hxy (by rw [h, mul_zero])
  have hsupport : SupportedOn T (D + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ)) := by
    intro i k hik
    have hne : ¬(s = i ∧ j = k) := by
      rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact hik hsj
    change D i k + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ) i k = 0
    rw [hD i k hik, Matrix.single_apply_of_ne s j (1 : ℝ) i k hne, zero_add]
  have hlt : D.rank < (D + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ)).rank := by
    change Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin) <
      Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (D + Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ)).mulVecLin)
    exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt
      (range_lt_range_add_single D hx hy s j hxj hys)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hmax _ hsupport)) hlt

theorem kernel_support {T : Set (I × J)} {D : Matrix I J ℝ}
    (hD : SupportedOn T D)
    (hmax : ∀ A : Matrix I J ℝ, SupportedOn T A → A.rank ≤ D.rank)
    {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker D.mulVecLin)
    (hy : y ∈ LinearMap.ker Dᵀ.mulVecLin)
    {s : I} {j : J} (hsj : (s, j) ∈ T) :
    x j * y s = 0 := by
  exact kernel_support_of_max_rank hD hmax
    (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx) (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hy) hsj

end SeymourSecondNeighborhood.LinearAlgebra.MaxSupportKernel

end OAI
```

FORMALIZATION B:
```lean
theorem helper_kernel_support_step1 {I J : Type*} {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ} {j : J} {s : I}
    (h : x j * y s ≠ 0) : x j * y s ≠ 0 := h

theorem helper_kernel_support_step2 {I J : Type*} [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    {T : Set (I × J)} {D Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ} {τ : ℝ} {s : I} {j : J}
    (hDτ : Dτ = D + τ • Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ))
    (hD : ∀ s' j', (s', j') ∉ T → D s' j' = 0) (hsj : (s, j) ∈ T) :
    ∀ s' j', (s', j') ∉ T → Dτ s' j' = 0 := by
  intro s' j' hnot
  have hne : ¬ (s = s' ∧ j = j') := by
    rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact hnot hsj
  rw [hDτ]
  simp [Matrix.single_apply_of_ne s j τ s' j' hne, hD s' j' hnot]

theorem helper_kernel_support_step3 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    [DecidableEq J] {D Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ} {τ : ℝ} {s : I} {j : J} {x : J → ℝ}
    (hDτ : Dτ = D + τ • Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ))
    (hx : D.mulVec x = 0) :
    Dτ.mulVec x = (τ * x j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) := by
  rw [hDτ, Matrix.add_mulVec, hx, zero_add, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.single_mulVec]
  ext i
  simp [Pi.single_apply, Function.update_apply]

theorem helper_kernel_support_step4 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    {Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ} {τ : ℝ} (hτ : τ ≠ 0) {s : I} {j : J} {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hstep3 : Dτ.mulVec x = (τ * x j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ))
    (hxy : x j * y s ≠ 0) :
    (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin := by
  have hxj : x j ≠ 0 := fun h => hxy (by rw [h, zero_mul])
  have hc : τ * x j ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hτ hxj
  have hmem : (τ * x j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin :=
    ⟨x, hstep3⟩
  have hs := (LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin).smul_mem (τ * x j)⁻¹ hmem
  rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul] at hs
  exact hs

theorem helper_kernel_support_step5 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    [DecidableEq J] {D Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ} {τ : ℝ} {s : I} {j : J}
    (hDτ : Dτ = D + τ • Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ))
    (step4 : (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin) :
    ∀ w : J → ℝ,
      (D.mulVec w = Dτ.mulVec w - (τ * w j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ)) ∧
        D.mulVec w ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin := by
  intro w
  have heq : D.mulVec w = Dτ.mulVec w - (τ * w j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) := by
    rw [hDτ, Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.single_mulVec]
    ext i
    simp [Pi.single_apply, Function.update_apply]
  refine ⟨heq, ?_⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact (LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin).sub_mem ⟨w, rfl⟩
    ((LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin).smul_mem (τ * w j) step4)

theorem helper_kernel_support_step6 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    {D Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ}
    {τ : ℝ} {s : I} {j : J}
    (step5 : ∀ w : J → ℝ,
        (D.mulVec w = Dτ.mulVec w - (τ * w j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ)) ∧
          D.mulVec w ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin) :
    LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin := by
  rintro z ⟨w, rfl⟩
  exact (step5 w).2

theorem helper_kernel_support_step7 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J]
    {D : Matrix I J ℝ}
    {s : I} {y : I → ℝ}
    (hyann : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin, y ⬝ᵥ v = 0) (hys : y s ≠ 0) :
    (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∉ LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin := by
  rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
  have h0 := hyann (D.mulVecLin w) ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [hw] at h0
  apply hys
  simpa [dotProduct, Pi.single_apply] using h0

theorem helper_kernel_support_step8 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I]
    {D Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ} {s : I}
    (step4 : (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin)
    (step6 : LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin)
    (step7 : (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∉ LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin) :
    Dτ.rank > D.rank := by
  have hlt : LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin < LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin :=
    lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨step6, fun hge => step7 (hge step4)⟩
  exact Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt

theorem helper_kernel_support_step9 {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] {T : Set (I × J)}
    {D Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ}
    (hmax : ∀ A : Matrix I J ℝ, (∀ s j, (s, j) ∉ T → A s j = 0) → A.rank ≤ D.rank)
    (step2 : ∀ s j, (s, j) ∉ T → Dτ s j = 0) (step8 : Dτ.rank > D.rank) : False :=
  absurd (hmax Dτ step2) (not_le.mpr step8)

variable {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]

def SupportedOn (T : Set (I × J)) (D : Matrix I J ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ s j, (s, j) ∉ T → D s j = 0

theorem kernel_support {T : Set (I × J)} {D : Matrix I J ℝ}
  (hD : SupportedOn T D)
  (hmax : ∀ A : Matrix I J ℝ, SupportedOn T A → A.rank ≤ D.rank)
  {x : J → ℝ} {y : I → ℝ}
  (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker D.mulVecLin)
  (hy : y ∈ LinearMap.ker Dᵀ.mulVecLin)
  {s : I} {j : J} (hsj : (s, j) ∈ T) :
  x j * y s = 0 := by
  classical
  

  have habsurd1 : ¬(x j * y s ≠ 0) := by
    intro hsuppose1
    have step1 : x j * y s ≠ 0 := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step1 hsuppose1

    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ, τ ≠ 0 := ⟨1, one_ne_zero⟩
    set Dτ : Matrix I J ℝ := D + τ • Matrix.single s j (1 : ℝ) with hDτ
    have step2 : SupportedOn T Dτ := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step2 hDτ hD hsj

    have step3 : Dτ.mulVec x = (τ * x j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step3 hDτ (by simpa using LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx)

    have step4 : (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step4 hτ step3 hsuppose1

    have step5 : ∀ w : J → ℝ,
          (D.mulVec w = Dτ.mulVec w - (τ * w j) • (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ)) ∧
            D.mulVec w ∈ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step5 hDτ step4

    have step6 : LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range Dτ.mulVecLin := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step6 step5

    have hyann : ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin, y ⬝ᵥ v = 0 := by
        rintro v ⟨w, rfl⟩
        have hy' : Dᵀ.mulVec y = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hy
        have key := Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec D w y
        rw [hy', dotProduct_zero] at key
        exact key.symm
    have hys : y s ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        exact hsuppose1 (by rw [h, mul_zero])
    have step7 : (Pi.single s (1 : ℝ) : I → ℝ) ∉ LinearMap.range D.mulVecLin := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step7 hyann hys

    have step8 : Dτ.rank > D.rank := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step8 step4 step6 step7

    have step9 : False := by
        exact helper_kernel_support_step9 hmax step2 step8
    exact step9

  exact not_not.mp habsurd1
```
